parameters.content:
Pstore RSS → Pinterest

Watches https://pstore-gxbv.onrender.com/rss.xml every 6 hours and creates a pin for each new niche. Only-new dedup is stored in workflow static data (persisted after successful scheduled runs only).

Setup:
1. Install the community node n8n-nodes-pin-interest (Settings → Community nodes).
2. Create the "Pin-Interest OAuth2 API" credential from your Pinterest developer app (scopes: pins:write, boards:read, user_accounts:read; redirect https://<your-n8n>/rest/oauth2-credential/callback).
3. Run pinterest-list-boards.json once, copy the board id into "Prep Pin Payload".
4. Activate.

IMPORTANT: do NOT run this while Pinterest's native RSS bulk importer is also consuming /rss.xml — you would double-post every niche. Use one or the other.
